author: GamingBolt
description:
The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park certainly manages to nail down a unique vibe to Central Park and the surrounding region. But is that going to be enough to make it an expansion worth playing through? We returned to New York City to answer that question, and the trip’s been worth it for the most part.

Of course, we’re here to tell you all about it and help you decide if this one is worth your time. Join us as we walk through desolate streets, past the victims of a sinister force operating in the region, and through a hail of bullets from bad guys intent on preventing us from getting to the bottom of things in a story that’s quite interesting, all things considered.
title: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
In spite of being as formative and pioneering as it was, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake's core design is flawless and well executed. That core design can carry a modern AAA game to feeling like one of the best releases on the market. 

And therefore, by choosing to focus on the areas where the game was beginning to lag behind, especially in this day and age, by bringing the storytelling and production and presentation and polish up to the same standards as the core design, the developers have closed the gap.
title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Review - Hyrule Feels New Again

author: GamingBolt
description:
GTA 6 is almost here, and our thoughts are already moving towards all the things we can do in Leonida and the open world it’s bringing to our consoles. Of course, the story and side activities are an important part of that, but any fan of open worlds knows that simply exploring your map and finding cool things to do is a major draw.

Well, we think Leonida is going to capture that feeling quite well, and perhaps even evolve it in a game that’s been in development for a duration that potentially showcases its ambitions. As always, we come prepared to tell you why we think so, and give you a window into what we’re expecting to see once we finally have a copy to play with. 

Join us for a jaunt through Leonida that doesn’t come with an agenda, but could just turn out to be a day well-spent.

This video draws on published previews, interviews and official footage to explore how the game’s systems could come together. We’ve also included a few hypothetical scenarios and wishlist ideas, so
title: GTA 6 Is All Set To Do The Unbelievable
